answer: Every claim climbs the mesa of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the beacon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The hollow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, revoked by a single upheld challenge, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
